name: Sodium bicarbonate
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 2 to 5 mEq/kg over 4 to 8 hours, guided by blood gases and clinical state

serious: Tissue necrosis after extravasation of hypertonic solution
Hypernatremia and intracranial hemorrhage after rapid injection in infants

contraindications: Chloride loss from vomiting or continuous gastrointestinal suction

pk.metabolism: Bicarbonate converted to carbon dioxide and water (lungs)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Under 1% of filtered bicarbonate in urine at normal function; excess excreted by the kidney

sources.citation: Baxter Healthcare Corporation. (2026). Sodium bicarbonate injection 12.6 mg/mL (isotonic) [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA218524, set ID b50c858a-00c8-4cb2-ad73-8797f19e656d, version effective August 14, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
